title: Long-time dynamics of stochastic 2D hydrodynamic-type evolution equations driven by multiplicative Lévy noise
summary: This paper investigates the long-time dynamics of solutions for an abstract nonlinear stochastic hydrodynamic-type equation driven by multiplicative Lévy noise. The framework encompasses several key hydrodynamical models, including the stochastic 2D Navier-Stokes equations, magnetohydrodynamic equations, the magnetic Bérnard problem, as well as various stochastic shell models of turbulence. Under the assumption that the nonlinear noise coefficients satisfy local Lipschitz and linear growth conditions, we first establish global well-posedness using a truncation technique.
